--argumentfile.Name: --argumentfile
--argumentfile.description: Text file to read more arguments from. Use special path `STDIN` to read contents from the standard input stream

--console.Name: --console
--console.description: How to report execution on the console

--consolecolors.Name: --consolecolors
--consolecolors.description: Use colors on console output or not

--consolemarkers.Name: --consolemarkers
--consolemarkers.description: Show markers on the console when top level keywords in a test case end

--consolewidth.Name: --consolewidth
--consolewidth.description: Width of the console output. Default is 78

--debugfile.Name: --debugfile
--debugfile.description: Debug file written during execution. Not created unless this option is specified

--doc.Name: --doc
--doc.description: Set a documentation of the top level suite

--dryrun.Name: --dryrun
--dryrun.description: Sets the return code to zero regardless of failures in test cases. Error codes are returned normally

--exclude.Name: --exclude
--exclude.description: Select test cases not to run by tag

--exitonerror.Name: --exitonerror
--exitonerror.description: Stops test execution if any error occurs when parsing test data, importing libraries, and so on

--exitonfailure.Name: --exitonfailure
--exitonfailure.description: Stops test execution if any test fails

--expandkeywords.Name: --expandkeywords
--expandkeywords.description: Matching keywords will be automatically expanded in the log file

--extension.Name: --extension
--extension.description: Parse only files with this extension when executing a directory

--flattenkeywords.Name: --flattenkeywords
--flattenkeywords.description: Flattens matching keywords in the generated log file

--listener.Name: --listener
--listener.description: A class for monitoring test execution. Gets notifications e.g. when tests start and end

--log.Name: --log
--log.description: HTML log file. Can be disabled by giving a special value `NONE`. Default: log.html

--logtitle.Name: --logtitle
--logtitle.description: Title for the generated log file. The default title is `<SuiteName> Log.`

--maxassignlength.Name: --maxassignlength
--maxassignlength.description: Maximum number of characters to show in log when variables are assigned. Zero or negative values can be used to avoid showing assigned values at all. Default is 200

--maxerrorlines.Name: --maxerrorlines
--maxerrorlines.description: Maximum number of error message lines to show in report when tests fail. Default is 40, minimum is 10 and `NONE` can be used to show the full message

--metadata.Name: --metadata
--metadata.description: Set metadata of the top level suite

--name.Name: --name
--name.description: Set a name of the top level suite

--nostatusrc.Name: --nostatusrc
--nostatusrc.description: Sets the return code to zero regardless of failures in test cases. Error codes are returned normally

--output.Name: --output
--output.description: XML output file relative to --outputdir unless given as an absolute path. Default: output.xml

--outputdir.Name: --outputdir
--outputdir.description: Where to create output files. The default is the directory where tests are run from

--prerebotmodifier.Name: --prerebotmodifier
--prerebotmodifier.description: Class to programmatically modify the result model before creating reports and logs

--prerunmodifier.Name: --prerunmodifier
--prerunmodifier.description: Class to programmatically modify the suite structure before execution

--pythonpath.Name: --pythonpath
--pythonpath.description: Additional locations (directories, ZIPs) where to search libraries and other extensions when they are imported

--removekeywords.Name: --removekeywords
--removekeywords.description: Remove keyword data from the generated log file

--report.Name: --report
--report.description: HTML report file. Can be disabled with `NONE` similarly as --log. Default: report.html

--reportbackground.Name: --reportbackground
--reportbackground.description: Background colors to use in the report file. Given in format `passed:failed:skipped` where the `:skipped` part can be omitted

--reporttitle.Name: --reporttitle
--reporttitle.description: Title for the generated report file. The default title is `<SuiteName> Report`

--rerunfailed.Name: --rerunfailed
--rerunfailed.description: Select failed tests from an earlier output file to be re-executed

--rerunfailedsuites.Name: --rerunfailedsuites
--rerunfailedsuites.description: Select failed suites from an earlier output file to be re-executed

--rpa.Name: --rpa
--rpa.description: Turn on the generic automation mode. Mainly affects terminology so that "test" is replaced with "task" in logs and reports

--runemptysuite.Name: --runemptysuite
--runemptysuite.description: Executes suite even if it contains no tests

--settag.Name: --settag
--settag.description: Sets given tag to all executed tests

--skip.Name: --skip
--skip.description: Tests having given tag will be skipped

--skiponfailure.Name: --skiponfailure
--skiponfailure.description: Tests having given tag will be skipped if they fail

--skipteardownonexit.Name: --skipteardownonexit
--skipteardownonexit.description: Causes teardowns to be skipped if test execution is stopped prematurely

--splitlog.Name: --splitlog
--splitlog.description: Split the log file into smaller pieces that open in browsers transparently

--suitestatlevel.Name: --suitestatlevel
--suitestatlevel.description: How many levels to show in `Statistics by Suite` in log and report

--tagdoc.Name: --tagdoc
--tagdoc.description: Add documentation to tags matching the given pattern

--tagstatcombine.Name: --tagstatcombine
--tagstatcombine.description: Create combined statistics based on tags. These statistics are added into `Statistics by Tag`

--tagstatexclude.Name: --tagstatexclude
--tagstatexclude.description: Exclude matching tags from `Statistics by Tag`

--tagstatinclude.Name: --tagstatinclude
--tagstatinclude.description: Include only matching tags in `Statistics by Tag` in log and report

--tagstatlink.Name: --tagstatlink
--tagstatlink.description: Add external links into `Statistics by Tag`. Pattern can use `*`, `?` and `[]` as wildcards

--test.Name: --test
--test.description: Select tests by name or by long name containing also parent suite name like `Parent.Test`

--timestampoutputs.Name: --timestampoutputs
--timestampoutputs.description: Adds timestamp in a format `YYYYMMDD-hhmmss` to all generated output files between their basename and extension

--variable.Name: --variable
--variable.description: Set variables in the test data

--variablefile.Name: --variablefile
--variablefile.description: Python or YAML file file to read variables from

--xunit.Name: --xunit
--xunit.description: XUnit compatible result file. Not created unless this option is specified
